test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 03
subject: general
question:
Seven boxes, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

Only two boxes are kept below B. Only one box is kept above F. Only one box is kept between F and D. A is kept immediately above G. C is kept at some place below E. Which box is kept at the top?
solution:
Given: Seven boxes, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

1) Only two boxes are kept below B.

2) Only one box is kept above F.

3) Only one box is kept between F and D.

4) A is kept immediately above G.

5) C is kept at some place below E.
